articles.headline: SK Hynix plans HBM4E volume production in Indiana as memory shortage seen lasting through 2030
articles.summary: SK Hynix said it will begin volume production of next-generation HBM4E chips at its Indiana facility in the third quarter of 2029. The company’s warning that the memory chip shortage could persist through 2030 matters for AI infrastructure budgets, server procurement, and long-term supply planning.

articles.headline: Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-Flash aims to cut AI training costs
articles.summary: Reuters reported that Alibaba’s Qwen launched Qwen3.8-Flash with lower training costs. For businesses using or buying AI, lower training costs can pressure model pricing, improve deployment economics, and accelerate adoption of AI tools.

articles.headline: McKinsey says enterprise AI gains are rising, but costs remain a hurdle
articles.summary: IT Pro’s August technology archive highlights McKinsey’s finding that AI is beginning to pay off for enterprises, while rising costs and limited efficiency gains still constrain impact. That is directly relevant for companies deciding whether to scale pilots into production.
